challengeFindings.title: A feature branch that local dev already contains (a local merge or fast-forward of the branch into dev) gets featureBase = HEAD, so every default diff is empty: scan-diff --marker="[DEBUG-OBSERVE]" --expect-none passes with a leaked marker, the migration scan misses migrations and challenge gate sizes 0 lines

Ship's deferred sweep reads a diff measured from featureBase (its context diff passes no --base) while its Context tells it to scan disabled tests from origin/dev, so on a branch cut from a local dev ahead of origin/dev the sweep flags disabled tests in files its diff does not show, and the unpushed dev commits the PR merges go unreviewed by the diff the sweep reads

branches scan-diff without --base no longer fetches origin/dev before diffing, so build Step 16's migration scan and debug's no-leak scan measure from a stale origin/dev; a branch that merged a newer origin/dev then counts other features' migrations as its own and forces a full CI build

bkit status route computes cleanBase (now featureBase) on every call for every workflow and step, so when origin/dev was merged into a branch cut from local dev, each route call runs git merge-tree --write-tree and writes a fresh commit-tree object, a write and a merge on a read verb the workflows call many times per run

Unpushed local `dev` commits ride the feature push and PR into `origin/dev`, but the default-base gates no longer see them: a failed in-place `/bkit-debug` on `dev` leaves `[DEBUG-OBSERVE]` instrumentation commits on local `dev`, the next branch is cut from local `dev` (`devBase`), and the off-`dev` debug no-leak scan, the migration `FORCE_BUILD` scan, the challenge size gate, the security reviewer's diff and ship Step 5's diff all measure from `featureBase`, so the marker lines and migrations reach `origin/dev` unreviewed and unscanned
